facts.text: Tim recalls an epic block by LeBron in Game 7 of the '16 Finals that changed the game and won it.

evidence.quote: There was this Finals game a few years back with an epic block that totally changed the game and ended up winning it.
Remember that epic block in Game 7 of the '16 Finals? He chased down Iguodala and pinned the ball against the backboard.

facts.text: John references the same epic block by LeBron in Game 7 of the '16 Finals, highlighting its demonstration of determination and heart.

evidence.quote: Remember that epic block in Game 7 of the '16 Finals? He chased down Iguodala and pinned the ball against the backboard. That kind of determination and heart is why I love basketball.
Moments like that make me love sports and admire the players' determination and heart.

facts.text: Tim affirms that the epic block in Game 7 of the '16 Finals is the one John is referring to, and it was an awesome moment.

evidence.quote: Yeah, that's the one! It was awesome.

facts.text: John states that LeBron's moments of determination and heart are incredible and inspire him to push himself in basketball.

evidence.quote: LeBron's moments of determination and heart are incredible. It's why I enjoy playing and pushing myself.
